# IGNORE = confirmed false positive (handled at CDN/Cloudflare/ALB level)
# WARN   = real finding but non-blocking (track, raise to dev team)

column3: Strict-Transport-Security Not Set - enforced by Cloudflare
Missing Anti-clickjacking Header - X-Frame-Options set at CDN level
X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing - set at CDN/ALB level
Retrieved from Cache - expected Cloudflare CDN behaviour
Timestamp Disclosure Unix - systemic, low exploitability

column1: # IGNORE - Informational only, no actionable security risk

column3: Modern Web Application - detection alert only, not a vulnerability
Authentication Request Identified - informational, ZAP detecting auth flow
Session Management Response Identified - informational, ZAP detecting sessions
CSP X-Content-Security-Policy - obsolete header, informational
CSP X-WebKit-CSP - obsolete header, informational
Loosely Scoped Cookie - likely intentional for SSO across tandf.dev subdomains
Loosely Scoped Cookie (passive scanner variant) - same as 10033, intentional for SSO
Non-Storable Content - no-store on dynamic pages is intentional, not a vulnerability
Content-Type Header Missing - informational, observed on image proxy endpoint only
Source Code Disclosure File Inclusion - false positive on Next.js /_next/image proxy endpoint; ZAP heuristic misidentifies dynamic image responses as path traversal
Source Code Disclosure Python - false positive; ZAP matches 'for' keyword in journal article body text, not Python source code
Proxy Disclosure - Cloudflare is the expected proxy; TRACE/OPTIONS fingerprinting expected behaviour
Information Disclosure Debug Error Messages - false positive; 'under construction' is UI placeholder text on journal article pages, not a debug message
Cookie Slack Detector - __cf_bm (Cloudflare bot management) correctly has no effect on app responses
Cookie SameSite Attribute None - only triggered by Cloudflare __cf_bm bot-mgmt cookie; re-evaluate (promote to WARN/FAIL) if the app starts setting its own cookies
